display.summary: New manage.py dlux_backup, which Composer runs before an operator's command-line DjangoLux update or rollback, on top of 1.11.0b5.
highlights: manage.py dlux_backup takes a backup in the foreground and reports it as JSON; Composer 1.6.1b4+ runs it before `dlux update` / `dlux rollback`.
Includes 1.11.0b5: inline updates and rollbacks back up before Composer swaps the code.
Database migration: additive and inline-safe for 1.10.x installs (backup options and chain columns); none since 1.11.0b4.
